alice: FYI incoming intake from Hydra Labs 1 1. They want Private deployment of a 7B chem-safety model with customer-managed HSM, nightly redacted traces, and full safety evals. GA target ~3 weeks. Uploaded artifacts to gs://redwood-cs/hydra/ and a short prompt pack.

ben: Do we know artifact format, expected QPS, and latency SLOs? Any streaming requirements?

alice: Model is HF safetensors + tokenizer. They plan int8 post-train quant. QPS steady 7, burst 35. Target p50 <280ms for 512 tokens. Non-streaming for now.

carla: Ask them for a 150-example confirmed-fail set and a 1k safety prompt suite. Also need PHI field list for redaction and HSM attestation docs. I'll own evals.

intake-bot: Intake logged: HY-ONB-2026-999  assigned: cs-ops  priority: P2  ticket: CS-ONB-9123

ben: Scheduling sync w/eng + security tomorrow 11am PT. @carla will you run the baseline vs redwood-7b? Also confirm if weights should live in customer S3 or our storage.

carla: Taking evals. Plan: run 4k prompts, compute NER F1, hallucination delta, PHI leakage checks, and latency. Using harness: `./eval_runner --model s3://hydra/model.safetensors --prompts gs://redwood-cs/hydra/safety_pack.csv --baseline redwood-7b --metrics ner_f1,hallucination,phi_leak,latency`. Expect first-pass in 48h.

alice: Procurement warned of renewal risk if p50 >320ms at GA. Prioritize perf. If int8 misses SLOs recommend dedicated capacity or 4-bit + kernel tuning.

ben: Rollout suggestion: internal QA -> private canary (10%) -> ramp (50%) -> full over 14 days. Auto-rollback on safety regressions or PHI leakage. I'll record rollout policy in the ticket.

carla: Also request daily redacted CSV spec from the customer and their list of PHI fields. Pinged them for the failure set and attestations. Will update this thread with eval results.
